observations: Three photos show multiple used car engines and transmissions lined up on a wet, dirty ground in what appears to be an auto spare parts market.
The engines vary in condition: some have intake manifolds, others are stripped down to cylinder heads or blocks.
Photo 0 shows a row of engines with one in the foreground having a black intake manifold and visible timing cover.
Photo 1 is a wider shot of the same row, showing more engines and the market environment with people and stalls.
Photo 2 shows a different angle with engines in the foreground, some with black intake manifolds, others with exposed cylinder heads.
No visible branding or model tags are readable on any engine in any photo.
The seller claims it is a 'Toyota Corolla 2008 engine and transmission gear 2zr', but no such label is visible in any photo.
The watermark 'BLESSED CHILD' is overlaid on all photos.
